description: This file defines the class LePredicateImpl, which implements a 'less than or equal to' predicate for query criteria in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract predicate class and implements an accept method for a visitor pattern.

classes.name: LePredicateImpl
classes.description: A predicate class representing 'less than or equal to' condition in query criteria, implementing the accept method to support visitor pattern.

methods.name: LePredicateImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a value.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor and calls its visitLe method with the predicate's value.
